definition.en: A rocket that launches and accelerates a spacecraft.
definition.zh: 把飞船发射并加速的火箭。

definition.en: A propulsion section that can be separated from the remaining vehicle.
definition.zh: 可以与其余飞行器分离的一段推进结构。

definition.en: Force on a rocket associated with expelling propellant.
definition.zh: 火箭排出推进物质时所受到的力。

definition.en: Material carried by an engine system and expelled to produce thrust; here fuel and oxidiser together.
definition.zh: 发动机系统携带并排出以产生推力的物质；这里包括燃料与氧化剂。

definition.en: A substance that reacts with an oxidiser to release energy.
definition.zh: 与氧化剂反应并释放能量的物质。

definition.en: A substance that supports the fuel reaction; a rocket carries its own.
definition.zh: 支持燃料反应的物质；火箭自己携带它。

definition.en: A shaped outlet that guides expanding exhaust gas.
definition.zh: 引导膨胀排气的成形出口。

definition.en: The launch vehicle unit that provides guidance and control.
definition.zh: 为运载火箭提供制导与控制的部分。

definition.en: An Earth orbit used before departure toward the Moon.
definition.zh: 向月球出发前先进入的地球轨道。

definition.en: An acceleration that sends the spacecraft onto a path toward the Moon.
definition.zh: 把飞船送上通向月球轨迹的一次加速。

definition.en: Apollo cabin carrying the crew and returning through Earth’s atmosphere.
definition.zh: 搭载阿波罗乘员、穿过地球大气层返回的舱体。

definition.en: Apollo section supplying propulsion and support, discarded before re-entry.
definition.zh: 提供阿波罗推进与支持、再入前抛弃的舱段。

definition.en: The separate Apollo craft with descent and ascent stages for lunar landing and return to lunar orbit.
definition.zh: 具有下降级和上升级，往返月面与月球轨道的独立阿波罗飞行器。

definition.en: A protective surface that limits heating of the cabin during atmospheric entry.
definition.zh: 再入大气层时限制乘员舱受热的保护表面。

definition.en: A calculated change in velocity from an ideal exhaust speed and mass ratio; not a measured flight speed.
definition.zh: 由理想排气速度与质量比计算的速度改变量，不是实测飞行速度。
